cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'}), (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, a.resolutionId, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber, a.resolutionId LIMIT 15
question_en: List Huawei's TDocs that led to an agreement (tracing a company's contributions to the standard).
